description: Micromine is an integrated suite of mining software: Geobank for geoscience data logging and management, Origin for exploration, geological modelling and resource estimation, Beyond for mine design, planning and surveying, Alastri, Spry and Advance for open-pit and underground mine planning, Pitram for fleet management and mine control, and Nexus, a cloud platform for sharing data across teams. It is produced by Micromine, a Weir Group company, which reports 39 years of work, more than 3,200 active projects in over 120 countries and 22 offices. Coverage is global across metals and soft rock mining. Licences are commercial and prices are not published, so cost is paid; customers get free training through the Micromine learning system and support through a portal. Caveat: the home page is marketing material and does not describe file formats or model methods. For simulation it links geological models, mine plans and live fleet data, supporting capacity planning, scheduling optimisation and digital twins of mine operations that can test the effect of equipment or access failures. It is related to the Deswik and Datamine records in this catalogue, which are competing mine planning suites.
